items.t: High-pressure fuel pump can come loose and leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and fuel pipe (recall 18V-358)

items.t: Front end shakes when turning from a stop
items.note: Often done under warranty when the SUV was newer.

items.t: Brake lines at the master cylinder can crack (recall)
Tablet holder can stop head restraints from locking (recall)
Replacement headliner may lack impact foam (recall)
Tire and loading label shows the wrong weight limit (recall)
A/C blows hot air to the rear seat
items.job: Diagnose A/C and replace evaporator or compressor
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,548–$2,094 for an evaporator; owners report bills averaging about $4,500.

items.t: Fuel filler door breaks
items.job: Replace fuel filler door and housing
items.note: Owners report an average of about $700.

items.t: Service Power Steering message and heavy steering
items.job: Diagnose power steering and apply bulletin repair
items.note: Often a software or connector fix; a new steering gear is at the high end.

items.t: Misfire and check engine light from moisture in the charge air cooler
Oil leak from a lower engine bolt
Service Brake Assist message with check engine light
items.job: Repair brake booster vacuum sensor or wiring (bulletin 21NA107)

items.t: Electric parking brake won't release or shows a service message
items.job: Replace rear caliper and parking brake actuator, or recalibrate

items.t: Auto stop/start stops working with a check engine light
items.job: Test and replace 12V battery or clean terminals, then clear codes

items.t: Rough idle, long cranking or misfire from injector deposits
Coolant leak at the coolant control valve
items.job: Replace coolant control valve and refill coolant

items.t: 9-speed automatic shifts oddly or sets a transmission code
items.job: Diagnose transmission; update software or replace control solenoid valve body

items.t: Check engine light in freezing weather from the crankcase pressure sensor
items.job: Apply crankcase pressure sensor bulletin repair

items.t: Check engine light for a fuel vapor pressure sensor code
items.job: Diagnose EVAP system and replace pressure sensor

items.t: Low turbo boost with code P0299
No Fob Detected message and no start
items.job: Replace and program body control module

items.t: Starter grinds or rattles when starting
Airbag warning light may not work reliably (recall)
Daytime running lights stay on with the headlights (recall)
Infotainment glitches with phone projection, audio or screens
items.note: GM says not to replace radio or display hardware for these symptoms; usually covered by warranty.

items.t: Navigation and personalization settings unavailable
items.note: No parts should be replaced, per GM.

items.t: Check engine light or no start from a wiring junction block
items.job: Replace engine wiring harness junction block
items.note: Should be covered by the factory warranty on these model years.

items.t: All-weather floor mat can trap the gas pedal (recall)
items.job: Modify or replace driver's floor mat (recall 24E-066)

items.t: Tire information label missing (recall)
